host.hostcpu.inputs: Runnable host threads and CPU operator work from the engine, with the process affinity and scheduling configuration.
host.hostcpu.outputs: Scheduled thread execution and CPU work completion, including host-side tokenization, scheduling and device submission.
host.hostcpu.consumer: Host-side request processing and the kernel dispatcher use CPU execution and any supported CPU operator path.
host.hostcpu.evidence: Under a fixed worker count and workload, record scheduling delay separately from active CPU execution.

host.device.inputs: Admitted kernel launches with device-accessible buffers, stream dependencies, synchronization and launch configuration.
host.device.outputs: Executed kernels, results in their destination buffers and completion or error status through the device runtime.
host.device.consumer: The kernel dispatcher, execution graph backend and buffer owners use device completion to advance or release work.
host.device.evidence: Record device and runtime identity and clocks, then compare a measured kernel with a matched shape and precision ceiling.

host.dram.inputs: Allocated physical backing and CPU or accelerator memory requests from the engine, including shared-address accesses and explicit transfers.
host.dram.outputs: Storage and access for resident weights, KV, workspace, staging and activations across the host memory topology.
host.dram.consumer: The accelerator, CPU, and engine state and weight components use these bytes. The placement planner accounts for their physical backing.
host.dram.evidence: Measure the actual access path and payload sizes on the target. Verify the unified memory ledger counts shared physical pages once.

host.ssd.inputs: Requested checkpoint shard paths, offsets and lengths via the filesystem, mapping or configured I/O path.
host.ssd.outputs: Requested checkpoint bytes and read completion or I/O failure. Service time can depend on the operating system cache.
host.ssd.consumer: The checkpoint reader and expert weight cache use returned byte ranges for tensor binding and exact-demand expert fills.
host.ssd.evidence: Verify known byte ranges under documented cold and warm cache conditions, alignment and concurrency. Track short reads, page faults and cache hits separately from device storage time.
